claims.locator: scholarly history and theorem survey excerpts

claims.statement: Banach 1922 Fundamenta Mathematicae 3:133–181 article on abstract operations and integral equations
Banach 1931 Polish Operacje liniowe and 1932 French Théorie des opérations linéaires distinction
sup distance between x and x² on [0,1] is 1/4

C([0,1]) with supremum norm complete; with L1 norm not complete

claims.locator: sum two triangular errors of area1/(4n) each

caveats: 1904 Hilbert integral equation is not identical to modern axiomatic Hilbert space; Fréchet1906 and Riesz-Fischer1907 separate contributions.
Banach 1922 paper and 1931 Polish / 1932 French treatise are different works and dates.
Different norms yield different function-space completions, and L1/L2 use a.e. equality classes.
Ramp function n≥3 has L1 distance1/(2n), discontinuous limit not contained in C([0,1]); no false sup convergence.
